sn42.2:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
sn42.2:1.2: atha kho tālapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho tālapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.2:1.3: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ naṭānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.2:1.4: yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.2:1.6: alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ. mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.2:1.7: dutiyampi kho tālapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.2:1.8: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante, pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ naṭānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.2:1.9: yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.2:1.11: alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ. mā maṃ etaṃ pucchīti.
sn42.2:1.12: tatiyampi kho tālapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn42.2:1.13: sutaṃ metaṃ bhante, pubbakānaṃ ācariyapācariyānaṃ naṭānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.2:1.14: yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatīti.
sn42.2:2.1: addhā kho tyāhaṃ gāmaṇi na labhāmi
sn42.2:2.5: pubbe kho gāmaṇi, sattā avītarāgā rāgabandhanabaddhā,
sn42.2:2.6: tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā rajanīyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyo sarāgāya.
sn42.2:2.7: pubbe kho gāmaṇi sattā avītadosā dosabandhanabaddhā.
sn42.2:2.8: tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā dosanīyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyo sadosāya.
sn42.2:2.9: pubbe kho gāmaṇi, sattā avītamohā mohabandhanabaddhā.
sn42.2:2.10: tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā mohanīyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyo samohāya.
sn42.2:2.11: so attanā matto pamatto pare madetvā pamādetvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā pahāso nāma nirayo tatthuppajjati.
sn42.2:2.12: sace kho panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti
sn42.2:2.13: “yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjatī”ti, sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi.
sn42.2:2.14: micchā diṭṭhikassa kho panāhaṃ gāmaṇi purisapuggalassa dvinnaṃ gatīnaṃ aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi
sn42.2:3.1: evaṃ vutte tālapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi parodi, assūni pavattesi.
sn42.2:3.3: alaṃ gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā maṃ etaṃ pucchī”ti.
sn42.2:3.4: nāhaṃ bhante etaṃ rodāmi, yaṃ maṃ bhagavā evamāha,
sn42.2:3.5: apicāhaṃ bhante pubbakehi ācariyapācariyehi naṭehi dīgharattaṃ nikato vañcito paraddho;
sn42.2:3.6: “yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti, so kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjatī”ti.
sn42.2:3.8: seyyathāpi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti. evamevaṃ bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
sn42.2:3.9: esāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
sn42.2:3.10: labheyyāhaṃ bhante bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyaṃ upasampadanti.
sn42.2:3.11: alattha kho tālapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, alatthupasampadaṃ.
sn42.2:3.12: acirūpasampanno ca panāyasmā tālapuṭo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto …pe… aññataro ca panāyasmā tālapuṭo
